Class CasseroleProperties.Ssh

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.config.CasseroleProperties.Ssh
Enclosing class:
CasseroleProperties
public static class CasseroleProperties.Ssh extends Object
The Ssh type holds the SSH server bind and password defaults. The port starts at 2222. The user name starts at clay. The password starts at butter. The host-key file starts at hostkey.ser. The idle timeout starts at 0, which means the server does not disconnect an idle session.

clayl (2026-08-24)

    • getIdleTimeoutMs

      public long getIdleTimeoutMs()
      The getIdleTimeoutMs method returns the idle limit in milliseconds. A value of 0 disables idle disconnect.
      Returns:
      The stored millisecond count.

    • setIdleTimeoutMs

      public void setIdleTimeoutMs(long idleTimeoutMs)
      The setIdleTimeoutMs method stores the idle limit. The method stores a negative value as given. A stored value of 0 or less means the server does not disconnect an idle session.
      Parameters:
      idleTimeoutMs - The limit in milliseconds, where 0 or a negative value means never.
